interpretation: Independent implementation agreement and mechanism attribution on a declared development selection; not phenotype accuracy, not transporter evidence, not the full benchmark

tolerances.outcome: growth class must be identical (threshold = protocol.growth_threshold)

declaration.declared_before: the first run of benchmark/v3/check_community_cobra.py and of the bounded revision-2 production fixture built from this file
declaration.basis: pairs chosen as complementary auxotrophs in unrelated pathways (mechanistic), plus one pair with a viable monoculture; measured labels are neither read to choose nor to evaluate
declaration.not_held_out: these pairs were examined in docs/v3-community-diagnosis.md; this is a development check of the engine, not a held-out evaluation and not evidence about the 1,035-pair benchmark
declaration.expected_outcomes_declared: none; the oracle reports agreement with production and attribution, it does not assert a biological expectation
